project_type: Next.js 16 TypeScript multi-tenant SaaS CRM with Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL
build_system: npm with Next.js build, no middleware.ts at root level
test_framework: vitest with tests/unit and tests/integration directories
verification_instructions: Run npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit to verify changes compile and existing tests pass
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. Node.js available. No running PostgreSQL or Redis available so verification is limited to typecheck + unit tests.
contribution_requirements: Standard TypeScript conventions, Drizzle ORM for DB access, zod schemas for validation
key_patterns: API routes in app/api/tenant/ use requireAuth() middleware, return NextResponse.json. Business logic in lib/. Schema in drizzle/schema/. Two error handlers: legacy apiError() in lib/api-error.ts and new handleError() in lib/errors.ts. Cache in lib/cache/index.ts with Redis + memory fallback.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. app/api/tenant/ - authenticated tenant API (454 route files). app/api/auth/ - authentication endpoints. app/api/cron/ - scheduled jobs. lib/ - business logic (274 files). drizzle/ - ORM schema and migrations. components/ - React UI. tests/ - vitest unit and integration tests.
